laws.rule: KCCA publishes the primary 2006 Kampala law-and-order ordinance. Paragraph 7(e-j) makes excessive noise/disturbance, being drunk in a street/public resort, riotous/disorderly behaviour and public urination/defecation or spitting offences. This is city-specific published text, not a claim all Ugandan districts have the same ordinance. Later amendments/current consolidation not yet checked.

Kampala ordinance paragraph 24: pitching a tent, parking a caravan or camping outside a private compound or Council-designated camping land requires a Council permit, which may have conditions. This exception structure is retained; no blanket city camping permission or ban inferred. Current issuing procedure and amendments not yet checked.

Uganda National Museum standard visitor policies allow photography without flash in galleries, exclude gallery food/drink, check large bags at entry and request quiet voices. A separate official closure notice says the museum is temporarily closed for renovation; these policies do NOT establish current admission or a reopening date.

items.text: Kampala published ordinance paragraph 7(f) makes being found drunk in a street or place of public resort an offence. This is not a prohibition on every purchase or consumption of alcohol; later amendments/current consolidation not yet checked.
Uganda National Museum visitor policy prohibits smoking on museum premises. Museum is separately listed as temporarily closed for renovation; no current entry entitlement inferred.

culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Department of Museums and Monuments, for Uganda National Museum visitor policies only.
culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Museum visitor policy requests quiet voices, no food/drinks in galleries and entry checks of large bags. The published renovation closure is not treated as permission to enter.
culture-and-protocol.photography_and_story_permissions: Museum photography is allowed without flash in galleries under its standard visitor policy; archival/research collection access is by appointment. Community ceremonial and storytelling permissions not yet checked.
culture-and-protocol.note: Museum protocol, not all Kampala communities. No assumption that a generic timetable establishes reopening.
